summary: Retain runtime GetSetRecord and iterator semantics when the set-like object can expose getters, Proxies, or dynamic callables.

semantics.iterator: GetIteratorFromMethod on keys; abrupt completions propagate with iterator protocol semantics

tests.name: observable property order
tests.input: const log=[]; const o={get size(){log.push('size');return 0},get has(){log.push('has');return ()=>false},get keys(){log.push('keys');return function*(){}}}; new Set().union(o); console.log(log.join(','));

caveats: Do not lower to LINQ Union: the set-like protocol and property/call ordering are observable.
